title: status.sh --json (contract 1)
description: Live state of a plan, computed from the task headers. Consumers ignore keys they do not know. See core/contract/contract.md for how each value is computed.

language.description: language from plan.json, pt-BR when absent. Passed through as text.

profile.description: profile from plan.json, full when absent. Passed through as text.

scripts_version.description: The '# scripts_version: <N>' stamp of the status.sh that produced this output, or null when the stamp is missing.

total.description: Tasks that pass the filter, minus the cancelled and abandoned ones.

pct.description: round(100 * done / total), halves rounded up; 0 when total is 0.

parallel.description: Ids of available tasks suggested for parallel sessions.

run.description: Latest autopilot log under notes/, or null when there is none.

log.description: Path relative to the plan folder: notes/run-YYYY-MM-DD[-N].md.

open.description: true while the log has no line starting with '## Closing'.

handoff.description: Title of the last '## Handoff' line of the log, without '## Handoff', the separator and surrounding spaces; only 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' when it starts with that stamp; null when the log has none. Since scripts_version 8; readers treat a missing key as null.

title.description: First '# ' line of PHASE.md without the '# '; the folder name when there is none.

total.description: Tasks of the phase that pass the filter, minus the cancelled and abandoned ones.

abandoned.description: Present, and true, only when every task of the phase (the whole phase, not only the filtered tasks) is cancelled or abandoned and at least one is abandoned. Since scripts_version 9; readers treat a missing key as false.

id.description: Task id, F<n>-<nn>[.<k>…], from the file name.

status.description: The Status: value as written (empty when absent). Values outside draft, ready, in-progress, done, cancelled, abandoned put the task in the invalid group.

type.description: The Type: value as written; empty when absent.

track.description: The Track: value as written; empty when absent.

tier.description: The Tier: value normalized: junior or mid when written exactly so, senior otherwise. Written by status.sh since scripts version 6; absent in output from older scripts, where it counts as senior.

waiting_on.description: Only in the blocked group: the blockers that are not done; an id that matches no task file gets the suffix (?).

unblocks.description: How many tasks that are not done, cancelled or abandoned cite this id in Blocked by:, over the whole plan (the filter does not apply).

next_step.description: Text after the marker on the last line below the title that starts with 'Next step:' (after optional spaces and an optional '- ' or '* '), or null.

file.description: Path of the task file relative to the plan folder.

replaced_by.description: The Replaced by: value (the task that took this one's place). Present only when the header has the key with a non-empty value. Since scripts_version 9; readers treat a missing key as null.

given_up_by.description: The Given up by: value (owner, on the root of a give-up). Present only when the header has the key with a non-empty value. Since scripts_version 9; readers treat a missing key as null.

given_up_with.description: The Given up with: value (the id of the root the task fell with). Present only when the header has the key with a non-empty value. Since scripts_version 9; readers treat a missing key as null.
